title: Reconstruction Change Order Pricing Sheet: Line, Markup and Rounding
content:
A Reconstruction change order is priced from the proposal awaiting signature: its scope code, the quantity written on it and the unit price written on it.

**Pricing clause.** The change order line is priced at the billed quantity times the change order unit price. The billed quantity is the quantity written on the proposal. The change order unit price is the tier's rate for the scope code, or, for a scope code that has no tier rate (an upgrade or escalation line), the unit price written on the proposal. The change order markup rate is the tier's change order markup percentage. The change order amount is put together in this order: first the billed quantity times the unit price gives the change order line; any treatment or cleaning charged on the quantity written on the proposal is added to that line; the change order markup rate is applied once to that sum; any fixed item the change order carries is then added without markup; and only the final total is rounded to the cent, half up.

## Tier rate for each scope code

| Scope code on the proposal | Tier rate used |
|---|---|
| drywall | drywall hang, tape and finish rate, per square foot |
| paint | seal and two coats of paint rate, per square foot |
| insulation | batt insulation install rate, per square foot |
| baseboard | baseboard install, caulk and paint rate, per linear foot |
| carpet install | carpet and pad install rate, per square foot |
| luxury vinyl plank install | vinyl plank install rate, per square foot |
| tile install | tile install rate, per square foot |
| cabinet install | cabinet install rate, per linear foot |
| carpenter labor | finish carpenter rate, per hour |
| painter labor | painter rate, per hour |
| dumpster | roll-off dumpster fee, per placement |
| final cleaning | final cleaning fee, per contract |
| flooring upgrade, cabinet upgrade, fixture upgrade, material escalation | no tier rate: the unit price written on the proposal |

The rates are those of the contract's own agreement in the company's unit price list; the markup percentage is the agreement's change order markup.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

Assumed for illustration: an agreement whose baseboard rate is $5.00 per linear foot and whose markup is 18%.

- Baseboard line, 86 linear feet written: 86 times $5.00 is $430.00; the markup of 18% on $430.00 is $77.40; the amount is $507.40.
- Material escalation line, 400 square feet written at a written unit price of $1.75: 400 times $1.75 is $700.00; with the 18% markup the amount is $826.00.

Rounding happens once, on the final total: a line of 37.5 linear feet at an assumed $3.33 is $124.875, which with an assumed 18% markup is $147.3525 and is rounded only then, to $147.35.
